other_failure_modes.name: Target leakage in manual target encoding
other_failure_modes.description: When manually implementing target encoding, the agent calculates the mean target over the entire training fold and maps it directly back to the same training fold. Because a sample's own target is included in the mean, this causes target leakage and overfitting. Proper encoding requires leave-one-out calculation or an inner K-fold loop.

other_failure_modes.name: Categorical features passed as continuous to Neural Network
other_failure_modes.description: The agent uses LabelEncoder to convert nominal categorical features into integers, scales them with StandardScaler, and feeds them directly as continuous inputs to a Neural Network. This incorrectly imposes an arbitrary ordinal relationship on the categories. Embedding layers or one-hot encoding should be used for categorical inputs in neural networks.
